label: Literature Search Ingest
description: Search scholarly sources, review candidates, research approved papers in agent-chosen subagent groups, collect independent per-paper payloads as they complete, then serially ingest them into Zotero.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Optional search query or seed. Leave blank with auto mode to start a guided search-planning conversation.

searchMode.title: Search Mode
searchMode.description: Choose auto detection, guided search planning, topic expansion, paper seed expansion, or exact targeted ingest.

searchBreadth.title: Search Breadth
searchBreadth.description: Choose broad multi-lane discovery, balanced coverage, or a quick first pass.

languageHints.title: Language Hints
languageHints.description: Optional BCP 47 language hints such as en, zh-CN, ja, or de. They expand queries and sources but never filter other languages.

targetCollection.title: Target Collection
targetCollection.description: Optional Zotero collection for created or existing items.
